verdict.rationale: AgentMail is API-first: inboxes are created and operated "entirely via API", agents can self-register to obtain an API key, and scoped and permission-restricted keys suit unattended automation. An official CLI and a published OpenAPI spec support scripted, headless use. Missing for 10: explicit CI documentation (e.g., a GitHub Action, non-interactive CLI auth via environment variables, CI examples) and independent hands-on reports of running it in CI pipelines.
